title: Excellent tour
text: Stepan was an excellent guide for my entire family, including grandparents in their 80s and my 21 year old son. He was a great communicator and even managed to get us out of town on a day when all the roads were blocked off due a marathon. He was able to personalise the trip for us and include a wonderful winery in the itinerary. After telling us all about Montserrat he took my son and me for a hike, and then introduced us to some friends at the farmers market. author: katiemW4613EF

title: Our Favorite Day
text: Absolutely the best tour guide we’ve had yet, and we have done several tours for just the two of us over the years. Stepan was friendly, knowledgeable and recognized what we could and could not do and catered the day around our speed and interests.  Montserrat is amazing and will not disappoint.
author: Lorin_H

title: Great personalized tour at one of the best tourist sites near Barcelona.
text: During our many years of travel we have never found a tour as good as this one. Stepan, our guide was easy to communicate with once we booked.  He picked us up, with our luggage, at our hotel in his spotless van and along the way to Montserrat provided general information on the region. At the beginning of our tour he gave us options so that we could have the exact experience we wanted. He was able to secure tickets to the boys choir performance knowing that we really wanted that opportunity.  First we hiked the region at a pace that was comfortable for us so that we could enjoy the journey. W
author: nidigrap

title: Great Day at Montserrat
text: Had a great day with Stepan as our guide!  He was punctual, very informative, and flexible according to the needs of our group.  We did a small hike down the mountain and learned about the history of the city and the mountains.  Saw the monastery and museum and overall had a wonderful time.  I would recommend the tour and Stepan as a guide and will be back to book more tours with them!
author: alexandrahI8926YF

title: Wonderful Montserrat
text: Stephen was very knowledgeable and customized the tour for my physical limitations.   The little side stop at the farmers market was great.  He is well known to all the folks at the site since he takes groups there 3-4 times a week
author: Dean_S

title: Magical Montserrat!
text: Montserrat is magical! Stefan picked us up at our hotel. It was a beautiful drive from Barcelona. Stefan is an expert on the area. The cathedral and the Black Madonna are fascinating. The museum was full of art from the masters. Picasso, Monet, Dahli and more.
author: Sherry_H

title: Montserrat Monastery Basilica and Black Madonna
text: This one of the most beautiful tours we have taken. Our guide, Stephan Prindis, was fabulous. He was very knowledgeable and catered the trip to our needs. Next time in Barcelona we will be sure to request him.
author: Mary_B

title: One of the Best
text: This was a fantastic tour. Stepan was extremely knowledgable and made sure the family was well catered for. The whole experience was one of the best tours we have done as a family.
author: PAD4102

title: Highlight of our trip!
text: Amazing experience.  Stephan was an incredible guide and was the perfect blend of knowledgeable and fun.  He managed to engage our 14 year old and 8 year girls in the history and beauty of Montserrat with humor and wit.  The monastery is just beautiful with breathtaking views.  This tour was the highlight of our trip Barcelona - thank you Stephan!
author: V8503TDshannonm

title: Highly recommended
text: A fabulous day out. Stepan picked us up from the hotel at an accomodating hour and chatted to us on the way to Montserrat answering all our questions. He was patient and clear in explaining our day to us and gave us several choices of walks we could do based on our ability. It was hot and he was attentive and took great care of us. His commentary was interesting on a wide range of things from the history to the geology. He provided plenty of water.
